item.subject: science
item.stem: Meera's teacher shows the class slides of different human cells under a microscope. One cell is very long and thin, with thread-like branches. Which statement best explains how this shape helps the cell perform its specific function?

options.A: The long, branched shape helps the nerve cell carry messages quickly over long distances in the body.
options.B: The long, branched shape helps the cheek cell form a flat protective lining inside the mouth.
options.C: The long, branched shape helps the muscle cell contract and relax to move body parts.
options.D: The long, branched shape helps the red blood cell carry more oxygen through its round disc shape.
